blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Cebuano Mixed Martial Arts (MMA) standout Rhyle “Trickster” Lugo will put his skills to the test against Korean fighter Hyun-Woo Park in the main event of “Konvoy Fight Fest 04: Next Round” on Saturday, November 28, at the Grand Ballroom of Nustar Resort Cebu. Lugo and Park will battle for the King of Konvoy lightweight crown in what promises to be a highly anticipated Cebu-versus-Korea showdown.
